suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific ocular complication. Apply only to proliferative diabetic retinopathy with separately documented tractional retinal detachment. Do not generalize this source to nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy or unrelated rhegmatogenous detachment. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Diabetic retinopathy matches the source-specific phenotype
Independent diagnosis of Retinal Detachment with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors

Resolution of the publication guard: Apply only to proliferative diabetic retinopathy with separately documented tractional retinal detachment. Do not generalize this source to nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy or unrelated rhegmatogenous detachment.
